text: Hello Alicia. How's it going? Great, actually Belinda. I've just finished all my exams. That must be a relief. How did they go? Quite well, I think. I was really pleased with how I did. That's great. Are you alright? You look a bit fed up. Yeah, sorry, it's not you. I'm just having a few problems with my accommodation. Oh dear. What's the problem? Oh, I've just found out I can't continue to stay where I am at the moment. What a pain. How come? I don't really want to explain. Basically, I need to find something else and to be honest, I just don't need the stress. I can imagine. Can I do anything to help? No, it's okay. I'm sure it'll sort itself out, but thanks. Well, at least let me buy you a drink. Okay, that'll be nice. What would you like? A cappuccino would be good. Anything else? A bit of cake. Oh, go on, it'll cheer you up. Well, I have to see. That chocolate cake looks very nice. I think I'll join you to celebrate finishing my exams.
